response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, t.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.riskeval), ranked AS (SELECT grouped.*, scan_count::numeric / SUM(scan_count) OVER () AS scan_share, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scan_count DESC) AS position FROM grouped) SELECT site_code, risk_evaluation_status, average_compression_ratio, scan_count, scan_share FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY scan_share DESC, site_code, risk_evaluation_status;
